policy: Cost is not an exclusion criterion; buy books as needed. Book text stays local; the repo stores metadata and hashes only. Attribution rule (2026-10-16, replaces the same-day strict first-hand rule; see attribution_criterion_20261016.md): every principle must be the master's own thinking. Tier A: written, signed or spoken by the master alone. Tier B: published in the master's lifetime under their name with a named co-author, collaborator or co-signatory, in the master's voice. Tier C: the master's verbatim answers in published interviews, answers only. Tier D (excluded): third-party accounts, journalists' paraphrase, institutional material the master did not author, others' forewords or commentary. Edited collections count at the original's tier if unaltered and are dropped when the original is already in the corpus. Passage level: remove non-master spans before extraction and record removed ranges; supporting quotes must be the author's own words; flagged quotes get human review; tier-C-only principles need tier-A/B corroboration or are reported as uncorroborated.
